name: Mixtral 8x7B
notes: PARAMS: 46.7B is the safetensors count; the paper states 47B. ACTIVE: 13B is the paper's figure. Neither is contested, both are rounding. KV: 32 * 8 * 128 * 2 * 2 bytes = 131,072 bytes/token = 128 KiB/token, identical per token to Llama 3.1 8B despite being 5.8x the weights. That is the canonical MoE serving point: KV scales with the dense attention tower, not with the expert weights. No sliding window, so the naive KV figure is the real one here. Routed experts with no shared expert. The 2-of-8 ratio means at batch 1 decode a token touches 2 experts, which is friendlier to batching than top-1 routing and much friendlier than 8-of-128.
